title: Pink Flamingo | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Pink Flamingo is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.

normalized_matching_profile.name: Pink Flamingo
normalized_matching_profile.description: Welcome to Pink Flamingo, your new favorite beach house! Enjoy the quiet, upscale neighborhood of Seacrest Beach, conveniently nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, along Scenic 30A. You'll find countless options for dining, shopping, and entertainment just minutes from your door.Upon entering Pink Flamingo, you’ll enjoy the open living area with flat screen TV for watching your favorite shows, roomy dining area with side porch for convenient grilling out, and a large, well-appointed kitchen with ample granite counters, and all the comforts of home. On the same downstairs level, you’ll find a queen bedroom with private entrance, a walk-in closet, and hall bath with walk-in shower. If you’re visiting long enough to do laundry, there’s a large separate laundry room on this level for your use.The 2nd level of the home features 1 king master and 1 queen master, both with private baths - one with walk-in shower and the other with a separate shower and garden tub. The queen bedroom boasts a private balcony for enjoying the evening breezes.The 3rd level is great for the kiddos with 2 twin bunk beds and a trundle, private bath with walk-in shower, another private balcony, and a wet bar for snacks and beverages.Last but not least, you’ll have access to the most awesome lagoon pool, and located poolside is The Seacrest Beach Café. If you prefer a pool day, you can relax to your heart’s content while soaking up the sun and enjoying the convenience of the café. Or after a day at the beach, enjoy a happy hour while the kids refuel, and the adults enjoy a refreshing beverage!Take a leisurely 10-minute walk to the sugar sand beach or if you prefer, ride the complimentary shuttle that runs in-season. Either way, you’re sure to enjoy your stay. Put your worries aside, and make great memories with family and friends at Pink Flamingo.Your stay at Pink Flamingo comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 3 vehicles.* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Golf carts are not allowed in the Seacrest Beach community.
